units.source_text: 时人迷信：某时某地有凶神，对某人不利，其人必须迁地回避。

en.t: People of the time were superstitious: they believed that at certain times and in certain places there were evil deities who could bring harm to particular people, and that those people had to move elsewhere to avoid them.
Here, this was used as a pretext.
